brand.name: WebCrown
nav.label: Main navigation
hero.eyebrow: Apne business se connect karne ka naya tareeka
hero.title: Customers ko apni jagah ke andar laayein.
hero.description: WebCrown independent hotels, restaurants, shops aur growing local brands ke liye immersive, easy-to-use websites banata hai. Customers ko aane se pehle hi apni jagah ka feel dein.
hero.scroll: Explore karne ke liye scroll karein, ya panorama drag karein
language.title: Apni language chunein
language.description: Page ke top se aap ise kabhi bhi change kar sakte hain.
spaces.label: Aapke business ke liye spaces
space.hotel-lobby.title: Hotel lobby
space.hotel-lobby.description: Guests ke aane se pehle hi welcoming lobby, amenities aur easy booking options dikhayein.
space.hotel-lobby.alt: Premium boutique hotel lobby ka interior
space.hotel-suite.title: Hotel suite
space.hotel-suite.description: Calm room tour, thoughtful details aur direct availability enquiry se guests ko stay ka feel dein.
space.hotel-suite.alt: Warm aur elegant hotel suite ka interior
space.restaurant.title: Restaurant
space.restaurant.description: Dining space aur signature menu dikhayein, aur table booking ko sirf ek tap door rakhein.
space.restaurant.alt: Warm lighting aur dining tables wala elegant restaurant
space.cafe.title: Cafe
space.cafe.description: Cafe ka ambience, coffee aur menu dikhayein, aur customers ke liye contact karna simple banayein.
space.cafe.alt: Wood coffee bar wala bright specialty cafe
space.gym.title: Gym & fitness
space.gym.description: Training space, classes aur membership options dikhayein, taaki naye members ko start karna easy ho.
space.gym.alt: Neatly arranged equipment wala modern fitness studio
space.salon.title: Salon & spa
space.salon.description: Services, team aur appointment options ko polished website par dikhayein jo aapke studio jaisi thoughtful lage.
space.salon.alt: Mirrors aur styling chairs wala refined salon
space.boutique.title: Boutique
space.boutique.description: Clothing aur jewellery collections ko elegant gallery mein dikhayein aur personal enquiry ka option dein.
space.boutique.alt: Curated clothing aur jewellery boutique ka interior
space.bakery.title: Bakery
space.bakery.description: Apne bakes ko tempting product gallery mein dikhayein, custom orders aur direct enquiry ke saath.
space.bakery.alt: Pastry display counter wali artisan bakery
space.coaching.title: Coaching class
space.coaching.description: Courses, teaching style aur batches ko clearly samjhayein, taaki families confidence se enquiry karein.
space.coaching.alt: Bright modern coaching aur learning studio
space.furniture.title: Furniture studio
space.furniture.description: Designs, materials aur finished spaces explore karayein, phir custom quote ke liye enquiry lein.
space.furniture.alt: Thoughtfully styled furniture aur interiors showroom
space.brand-store.title: Local brand store
space.brand-store.description: Products ke peeche ki story batayein aur customers ko collection discover, compare aur enquire karne dein.
space.brand-store.alt: Minimal local product brand store ka interior
hotspot.services.copy: Ek thoughtful website aapke business ka intro de sakti hai, services highlight kar sakti hai aur visitors ko next step tak le ja sakti hai.
hotspot.booking.copy: Customers ke liye question poochna, availability check karna ya WhatsApp par booking start karna easy banayein.
hotspot.quote.copy: Apne business ke baare mein thoda batayein; hum ek clear aur practical website plan suggest karenge.
estimator.title: Website ka cost kitna ho sakta hai?
estimator.description: Business type, pages aur features chunein. Approximate range aur delivery time dekhein, phir WhatsApp par details bhejein.
estimator.note: Ye planning ke liye range hai, final price nahi. Aapki needs samajhne ke baad final range confirm karenge.
contact.title: Apne business ko dein explore karne layak website.
contact.description: Free first-page demo ke liye message karein. Hum aapka business samajhkar ek thoughtful starting point dikhayenge.
whatsapp.greeting: Hi WebCrown, mujhe apne business ke liye website chahiye.
whatsapp.estimate: Hi WebCrown, website ke baare mein baat karni hai. Package: {size}. Extra features: {features}. Estimate: {estimate}.
estimator.recipient: WhatsApp par ye estimate kisko bhejna hai?
estimator.pagesError: 1 se 30 ke beech pages ki sankhya daalein.
estimator.languageError: Website ke liye kam se kam ek language chunein.
estimator.quoteSavedError: Is device par estimate save nahi ho saka. Please dobara try karein.
portfolio.title: Local businesses aur brands ke liye banayi gayi websites.
portfolio.description: Restaurant ka live experience aur aap jaise businesses ke liye kuch concept ideas dekhein.
project.aishwaryam.title: Aishwaryam Restaurant
project.aishwaryam.description: Gate se billing counter aur tables tak explore karein, poora menu search karein, WhatsApp order mein dishes add karein aur table book karein.
project.cafe.title: Cafe experience
project.cafe.description: Concept: welcoming cafe tour, menu highlights aur aasaan enquiries.
project.gym.title: Fitness studio
project.gym.description: Concept: training floor, memberships aur class options explore karein.
project.hotel.title: Boutique hotel
project.hotel.description: Concept: lobby, guest rooms aur booking options dekhein.
